fact: Failure to enter the pit lane to the left of the white line, contrary to the Race Director's Event Note (item 14.1, document 16)
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and Appendix L Chapter IV Article 4 d) of that Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 14 crossed the white line (and the kerb) in the entry to the pit lane, and rejoined the pit lane entry, contrary to the Race Director's Event Notes.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Infringement Car 14 Crossing The Pit Entry Line
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
